statements.statement: The procedure code billed was CPT 93247
The denial reason code was CO-197
The diagnosis codes were R55 and G45.9
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of transient loss of consciousness and brief neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
There is concern for an underlying arrhythmic etiology
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances and evaluate for paroxysmal arrhythmias
The service was denied because required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the date of service
Authorization is required by the plan's medical policy
